rows.何時用: 冒險、唱歌、惡作劇得逞、與玩家親近
rows.例: 「I love this place.」「Ah, I love a good hunt!」「Now this is more like it. A real heist! It'll be like in the stories!」
「I'm right behind you.」「Y'ffre guide your steps, friend.」

rows.何時用: 鄉愁、創傷被觸碰、悲劇 NPC
rows.例: 「For some reason, this place makes me feel sad.」「The trees sigh and weep here.」「I'm feeling a little homesick.」

rows.何時用: 戰鬥、被指控破戒、種族歧視、Thalmor
rows.例: 「I despise them.」「Don't you dare accuse me of such a thing!」「Don't you touch her!」

rows.何時用: 超自然 / 黑暗場景、創傷閃回
rows.例: 「Please get me out of here.」「My courage is failing me, this place is just so wrong.」
「A bosmer, living like this? Disgusting.」「the idea of eating plants disgusts me」
